test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II ( JSO ) 2021 Official Paper ( Held On: 10 August 2022 )
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is INCORRECT?

options.text: For k treatments and N observations, the degree of freedom of variation within groups is N - k
For k treatments and N observations, the degree of freedom of total variation is N - 1
For k treatments and N observations, the degree of freedom of the ratio of mean sum of square of treatments and residual mean sum is N - 1 and k - 1
For k treatments and N observations, the degree of freedom of variation between groups is k - 1

solution:
The correct answer is **for k treatments and N observations, the degree of freedom of the ratio of the mean sum of the square of treatments and the residual mean sum is N - 1 and k - 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **The number of degrees of freedom is **k-1, N-K**, where m is the number of samples and N is the total size of all the samples together.
 
• The sampling distribution of the ratio of the variances of two samples taken from a normal population is known as the** F-distribution**. It is directly applied in determining whether two samples originate from populations with the same variance.
 
• The more significant usage is in **variance analysis**, even if you may infrequently see it employed to assess equality of variances (ANOVA). ANOVA is used to determine if three or more samples are from populations with the same mean, at least in its most basic form as described in this chapter.
 
• **ANOVA **determines whether the samples are from populations with equal means or not by determining whether the variance of the observations is more closely related to the variance of each observation from the mean of its sample or to the variance of the means of the samples from the overall mean.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The divergence of data points from the mean value is measured by the sum of squares.**
 
• While a smaller result shows little deviation from the mean, a bigger sum of squares suggests higher variability.
 
• Subtract the data points from the mean, square the differences, and then add the resulting amount to determine the sum of squares.
 
• **Total, residual,** **and regressive sums of squares are the three types.**
 
• The **sum of squares **can be used by investors to assist in improving their investing decisions.
